senses.gloss: Puṇḍarīka^1, an ancient king. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 325 (in the palace of Yama).
Puṇḍarīka^2, a tīrtha. § 364 (Tīrthāyātrāp.): III, 83, 6053.
Puṇḍarīka^3, a serpent. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 103, 3622 (enumeration).--§ 793 (Mausalap.): XVI, 4, †119.
Puṇḍarīkā, an Apsaras. § 191 (Arjuna): I, 123, 4819 (danced at the birth of Arjuna).--§ 549 (Pāṇḍavapr.): IV, 9, 259 (Sudeshnā asks Draupadī if she is P.).
Puṇḍarīkāksha^2 = Śiva (1000 names^1).
Puṇḍarīkavanālaya = Śiva (1000 names^1).
Puṇḍarīkekshaṇa (“lotus-eyed”) = Kṛshṇa: II, 951; XII, 896.
Puṇḍarīyaka, a Viśvadeva. § 749 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 91, 4359.

Puṇḍra^1, an ancient king. § 6 (Anukram.): I, 1, 228 (only B., C. by error has Pundraḥ; in Sañjaya's enumeration). --§ 170 (Dīrghatamas): I, 104, 4219 (the fourth son of Sudeshṇā, the wife of Bali, born by the touch of Dīrghatamas), 4221 (from him the Puṇḍras descended)
Puṇḍra^2 (“the king of the Puṇḍras”). § 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 22, 875 (ºsya nāgaṃ, at the time of the great battle).

Puṇḍra, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 170 (Dīrghatamas): I, 104, 4221 (descended from Puṇḍra^1).--§ 177 (Pāṇḍudigvijaya): I, 113, 4453 (vanquished by Pāṇḍu).--§ 273 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 14, 584 (Vaṅga-Pº-Kirāteshu rājā… Pauṇḍrako Vāsudeveti yo 'sau loke 'bhiviśrutaḥ).--§ 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1872 (paid tribute to Yudhishṭhira).-§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 358.--§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 50, 2083 (only B., C. has Pauṇḍrāḥ, in the army of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 93, 3380 (attacked Arjuna).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 9, 236 (º-Cīnakān, had formerly been vanquished by Karṇa).-§ 605 (do.): VIII, 22, 863.--§ 782e (Arjuna Kārtavīrya): XIV, 29, 832 (vṛshalatvaṃ parigatāḥ).--§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 82, 2464 (ºān sa-Kośalān, vanquished by Arjuna). Cf. Pauṇḍra, pl., Pauṇḍrika, pl., Puṇḍraka, pl.
Puṇḍrādhipa (“the king of the Puṇḍras”) = Vāsudeva (Pauṇḍraka): II, 1096 (Vº).
Puṇḍraka (“the king of the Puṇḍra(ka)s”). § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 119 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).
Puṇḍraka, pl. = Puṇḍra, pl. § 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1874 (Tāmraliptāḥ sa-Pºāḥ, so C., but B. reads supuṇḍrakāḥ).
Puṇya^1, name of a lake. § 377 (Dhaumyatīrthak.): III, 89, 8364 (hradaḥ, in the west). Cf. Puṇyākhya^2.
Puṇya^2 = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Puṇyā, a river. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 344 (so C., B. Supuṇyā).
Puṇyacañcu = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Puṇyaśloka = Nala, q.v.
Puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Puṇyajana, pl. (“good people”), a designation of certain supernatural beings, as Yakshas or Rākshasas: III, 475(?); VII, 2403, 2417; XV, 848; XVIII, 146.

Puṇyākhya^1, name of one or more hermitages. § 377 (Dhaumyatīrthak.): III, 90, 8382 (in the west; only C., B. has Pāñcālyāḥ).--§ 390 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 110, 9990 (āśramaś caiva Pºḥ Kāśyapasya, i.e. Vibhāṇḍaka's).-Do.^2, name of a lake. § 413 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 135, 10698 (apāṃ hradañ ca Pºṃ).
Puṇyakīrti = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Puṇyakṛt, a Viśvadeva. § 749 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 91, 4355.
Puṇyanāman, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2561.
Puṇyodakā, a river. § 766 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 130, 6125 (nadī, in the realm of death).
